ideas.pitch: An offline-first mesh networking app for women's safety that uses Bluetooth LE and optional blockchain logging for tamper-proof distress signals during crowded Pujo pandals.
ideas.title: DurgaGuard: Offline-First Women's Safety Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a high-priority social track specifically during a Durga Puja themed hackathon, leveraging local peer-to-peer connectivity when cell towers are jammed in large crowds.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and fitness tracking assistant tailored for managing metabolic health and preventing obesity during high-calorie festive seasons.
ideas.title: PujoNutri: AI Meal & Activity Planner for Metabolic Health
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven winning nutritional AI architectures directly to a localized cultural context, featuring a working live mobile demo that judges can interact with instantly.

ideas.pitch: An AI-agentic system that simulates and manages real-time pedestrian density, bottleneck risks, and emergency response workflows for large festival gatherings.
ideas.title: PandalsAI: Multi-Agent Crowd Flow & Emergency Management
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines multi-agent workflow automation with a critical real-world public safety challenge, appealing strongly to judges looking for autonomous operational value.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-deployment geospatial dashboard combining real-time satellite data overlays with automated early warnings for waterlogging and disaster management during severe weather.
ideas.title: FloodWatch Shakti: Early Warning Disaster Response Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features hard technical execution involving geospatial API integrations and clear, quantifiable social impact metrics for disaster preparedness.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight digital preservation platform with optional AR elements allowing users to explore and archive the historical craftsmanship of local Durga Puja pandals and idols.
ideas.title: PujoPedia: Interactive AR Cultural Heritage Archive
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly taps into the core festival ethos of the hackathon sponsor's theme, delivering a polished and emotionally resonant multimedia presentation.
